description: kb-identity/cases.json: the identity a reader computes from a knowledge base's project file.

dir.description: The knowledge base's directory, whose name stands for a name no file gives.

config.description: The text of <dir>/.xynolog/config.yaml, or null when there is none.

refused.description: Whether the file does not hold to ProjectConfig.json, and every reader refuses it.

name.description: The name read, or null when the file is refused.

domain.description: The domain read, or null when no identity is declared.

did.description: The DID the domain names, or null when no identity is declared.

resource.description: The resource derived from the domain, the audience the gateway's tokens must carry, or null when no identity is declared.
